theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (a : ℝ≥0∞), (∀ y : Euclidean N, MonotoneOn (densityRatio n μ y) (Ioi 0)) → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → μ (closedBall 0 ρ) = a * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) → ∀ (y : Euclidean N) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → densityRatio n μ y ρ ≤ a
